help.title: Down Sample
help.body:
Description
Down-Sampling Imbalanced Data. Randomly keeps, from each class of the selected variable, as many rows as the smallest class has, so that all classes have the same frequency as the minority class. All rows of the smallest class are kept.
Usage
BSkyDownSample(data, dependent)
Arguments
  • data: a data frame
  • dependent: the name of the variable whose classes (levels or distinct values) are balanced, as a character string
Details
Simple random sampling is used to down-sample the majority class(es). Rows where the selected variable is missing (NA) are left out, with a warning. Factor levels that no row has are ignored. Set seed makes the result reproducible.
Value
A data frame with the same columns, in the same order, as the original dataset. Rows keep their original order.
Examples
set.seed(12345)
DownSample <- BSkyDownSample(data = Dataset2, dependent = "gender")
table(DownSample$gender)
Package
BlueSky
Help
help(BSkyDownSample, package ='BlueSky')
